description: This PHP class defines a 'GreaterThanOperator' used for filtering in a JSON API context within the SuiteCRM project. It extends a base Operator class and implements an OperatorInterface to provide greater-than comparison functionality, including methods to generate filter and SQL representations and validate operators.

classes.name: GreaterThanOperator
classes.description: A class that performs 'greater than' filtering operations, providing methods to return filter and SQL representations and validate the operator input.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'gt' used in JSON API filter expressions.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL '>' operator for database queries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the input operator is a string and then defers to parent class validation.
